integrity: The known digit construction, unique representation and 3/2 limsup are attributed to prior work. The asserted contribution is the explicit sampled-ratio limiting law, W1 error bound, inverse-square mass 2/3 subcomponent, and rational CDF enclosure. No independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The probability law treats only the canonical base-four pair with digits {0,1} and {0,2}; the remaining absolutely continuous component of mass 1/3 has a convergent gap-density representation rather than a single elementary closed form. The full 2011 Chen-Fang source could not be inspected. Broader priority requires independent literature review. Finite checks do not certify the infinite theorem.
title: An inverse-square component in the limit law of a base-four additive complement
